recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the current-source cleanup for the applied FHIR-31906 terminology change without adding a new grantor search parameter beyond the existing applied source and later normative search-parameter curation.
issue_request: FHIR-31906 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 Consent. It requested a clearer way to represent the party to whom consent is granted and resolved to convert Consent.performer into Consent.grantee and Consent.grantor, with a usage note that fully computable consents should list grantee/grantor as actors in the consent and that the root elements are for ease of search.
initial_application: The main conformance change appears to have been applied by untagged May 2021 Consent commits: 632f4b8497 replaced Consent.performer with Consent.grantor and Consent.grantee in structuredefinition-Consent.xml, and 731c1d67fe changed the old consentor/performer search parameter to Consent.grantee. Current source/fhir.ini also maps old Consent.performer to Consent.grantee.
additional_context: Consent remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition, SVG, and search-parameter bundle already use grantor/grantee/controller/manager. FHIR-27778 separately split old Consent.organization into manager/controller, and FHIR-34302 later confirmed the grantor/grantee definitions. No direct Zulip or Confluence evidence was found for FHIR-31906.
reconciliation: Updated source/consent/consent-example-signature.xml to use <grantee> instead of the removed <performer> element, and updated source/consent/consent-notes.xml so the accountability bullet names the current grantee/controller concepts instead of obsolete organization/performer terminology.
source_changes: source/consent/consent-example-signature.xml: replaced the removed <performer> element with <grantee> in the signed Consent example.
source/consent/consent-notes.xml: changed the accountability model bullet from obsolete organization/performer wording to grantee/controller terminology.

related_jiras.note: The broader Consent concerns were resolved through derivative tickets, including the manager/controller and grantor/grantee work that became FHIR-31906.
This published issue split Consent.organization into Consent.manager and Consent.controller, explaining why old organization terminology also needed replacement.
This later published correction confirms the intended grantor/grantee semantics used by the current Consent definitions.
